class.name: FmodChannelGroup
class.brief_description: A group of channels FMOD mixes together, such as the one an event instance plays through.
class.description: Returned by [method FmodEvent.get_channel_group]. Its DSP clocks count the samples mixed, which lets game code schedule sounds in time with an event's audio.

method.name: get_dsp_clock
method.description: Returns this channel group's DSP clock, in samples mixed at the output rate.

method.name: get_parent_dsp_clock
method.description: Returns the DSP clock of this channel group's parent, in samples mixed at the output rate.
